An HTTP response status code must be a three-digit code between 100 and 599.

What the Standard says

RFC 9110 defines status codes as three-digit integers from 100 through 599, grouped into five response classes. Read section 15.

Why it matters

Values outside the defined range are not HTTP status codes and can be rejected or normalized unpredictably by servers, proxies, and clients.

Bad code example

[HttpGet]
public IActionResult Get() =>
    StatusCode(statusCode: 799);

Good code example

[HttpGet]
public IActionResult Get() =>
    StatusCode(statusCode: 500);
